justification: Both surfaces cover an entire upright, round-topped slab with a dense low-relief design built from curvilinear scrolls, volutes and schematic profile zoomorphic heads with scroll eyes and fanged jaws, stacked vertically to fill the field. The main difference in content is that A includes clearly figural, seemingly narrative elements (an upper human-like figure with an extended arm/implement over lower creature masks), whereas B is a purely abstract-zoomorphic interlocking scroll composition with no discernible human figure or narrative relationship.
